problem_test_quality.evidence: The brief exposes no hidden paths or test internals. Randomized hidden scenarios assert public compile/runtime behavior across compatible class, struct, enum, literal, nested, alternative, guard, exhaustive, generic, non-generic typed, no-implementation, associated-type, retained-GC, Cannon, and Boots cases; focused base cases preserve casts, direct patterns, diagnostics, and dispatch.

description_necessity.evidence: All 175 words define compatibility, runtime mismatch safety, supported pattern contexts, open-world exhaustiveness, representation safety, backend parity, or adjacent regressions. No HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW removal candidate was found.

problem_test_alignment.evidence: Two independent clause maps and adversarial/fairness reviews found every added assertion stated by the brief or repository-discoverable. Each material requirement has an observable oracle, rejection requires the repository's normal status 1 without pinning text, and no hidden structural implementation choice is required.

test_filename_collision.evidence: Blind defaults predicted trait-object-concrete-runtime.dora, trait-object-concrete-incompatible.dora, trait-object-concrete-ambiguous.dora, and trait-object-concrete-open.dora.
